meta_description: DJS Painting and Decorating in Southampton. Expert interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorative finishes. Local, reliable, fully insured.
hero_subhead: Professional interior and exterior painting that transforms your home. From fresh walls to complete redecorations, we deliver quality finishes on time and on budget.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Southampton
services_subhead: From interior refreshes to full exterior repaints, we handle every job with meticulous attention to detail and premium materials.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Transform any room with expert interior painting, including walls, ceilings, and woodwork. We prep surfaces properly and use quality paints that last.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Protect and refresh your home's exterior with durable exterior paint and rendering work. Weatherproof finishes that enhance curb appeal for years.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Precise wallpaper hanging, pattern matching, and feature wall installation. We work with all wallpaper types to create striking interior designs.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Keep your business looking professional with scheduled painting and maintenance. Flexible scheduling minimises disruption to your operations.

services.title: Cabinet & Furniture Painting
services.desc: Refresh tired kitchens and furniture with expert spray painting and hand finishing. Durable finishes that transform spaces without replacement costs.

services.title: Preparation & Surface Works
services.desc: Thorough surface preparation is the foundation of every job—sanding, filling, priming, and repairs ensure flawless paint adhesion and lasting results.

about_pullquote: Every wall we paint is someone's home. We treat it like our own.
about_para_1: DJS Painting and Decorating was established over a decade ago in Southampton, built on a simple promise: quality workmanship at fair prices. What started as a one-person operation has grown into a trusted team, completing hundreds of projects across Southampton and the surrounding areas. We're fully insured and take pride in turning tired interiors and weathered exteriors into spaces our customers love.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on reliability. We turn up on time, finish when we say we will, and leave your home spotless. Most of our work comes from repeat customers and personal recommendations—a testament to the care we put into every project. Whether you need a single room refresh or a complete exterior overhaul, we approach each job with the same professional standards.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Fantastic job on our lounge walls and hallway. Dan and the team were professional, tidy, and got the colour spot on. Finished a day early too. Couldn't ask for better. Will definitely book them again for the bedrooms next year.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.text: Had our kitchen cabinets painted and the transformation is incredible. Brilliant finish, no mess, and genuinely friendly lads. Got quotes from two other painters but DJS offered the best value. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Patricia L.

reviews.text: Front and back exterior needed doing after years of weather damage. They prep work was thorough—sanded, filled, primed the lot. Paint quality is excellent and the finish is immaculate. Best decision we made. Five stars.
reviews.author: Robert M.
